plan.notes: Transfer-oriented AA: students completing AA requirements with a 'C' or better should transfer 60-64 credit hours to most public four-year colleges/universities in Arkansas. Catalog placement/eligibility notes ('Placement score or required remediation', 'Eligible for Comp I', 'Eligible to take Comp I', 'Keyboarding exam or GBUS1103 recommended') are eligibility requirements, not course prerequisites; machine prereqs list only actual courses. Catalog note: where specific transfer plans/agreements require certain courses/hours, substitutions may be approved by the dean. Closing line prints 'Total Hours 60'.
